purpose: Review a finite positive operating-milestone disclosure domain with plausible three-session repricing relevance before opening announcement rows, titles, bodies, source values, candidate values, comparators or returns, while preserving the terminal major-contract source boundary.

repository_evidence.major_contract_boundary: The Eastmoney major-contract disclosure intensity branch is terminal after its consumed source acceptance and cannot be relabeled as order wins, customer validation or commercial milestones.
repository_evidence.domain_distinction: Capacity commissioning, formal product approval and patent or R&D milestones may represent issuer operating-state transitions rather than contract demand, but require separate frozen source and identity contracts.

must_freeze_before_any_formula_or_direct: exact official exchange or regulator announcement source, immutable document bytes, category universe and announcement identifier
first public timestamp, trading-session availability, correction, withdrawal and revision chain
issuer, listed security, subsidiary, project, facility, product, patent and jurisdiction mapping without current-state leakage
event identity separating plan, construction, trial run, formal commissioning, approval, certification, registration and commercialization
approval authority, approval scope, validity, conditional status and revocation or supplemental approval semantics
patent grant, application, licensing, clinical stage and research-milestone taxonomy with deterministic non-overlap rules
capacity, investment, output, addressable-market or milestone-severity primitives with stable units and disclosure scope
missing, undisclosed, unknown, not-applicable and genuine-zero semantics without treating absence as favorable
complete bounded 2019-2023 partition manifest, full-market denominator, pagination and one-shot acceptance gates
parser and source-acceptance tests that use no candidate, comparator, price or return values

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: capacity_commissioning_or_formal_start_of_production_disclosure
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known transition from investment or construction into usable production capacity.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No accepted contract separates plan, construction, trial production and formal commissioning while freezing subsidiary/project identity, capacity units, first availability, revisions and full 2019-2023 coverage.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: product_regulatory_approval_registration_or_certification_disclosure
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A formal product approval or certification that changes the issuer's authorized commercial opportunity set.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Approval authority, scope, conditional status, product/issuer mapping, supplemental approvals, validity, revisions and a full point-in-time denominator are not frozen in a local historical source.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: patent_grant_or_research_and_development_milestone_disclosure
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A formal intellectual-property or research milestone that may alter expected commercialization potential.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Applications versus grants, patent families, assignees, licenses, research stages, failed or superseded milestones and historical first-public timestamps lack a complete accepted contract.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: major_order_contract_award_or_customer_validation_disclosure
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A newly disclosed commercial demand or order confirmation.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The major-contract disclosure branch is terminal. Changing title literals to order win, framework agreement, customer validation or tender award would be a forbidden source-classification rescue.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: milestone_progress_delay_completion_or_capacity_ramp_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Progress or slippage relative to an earlier operating milestone.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing plan-to-completion delay, trial-to-formal transition, capacity ramp, age window or target gap cannot precede exact identity and point-in-time admission of the base milestone stream.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: combined_positive_milestone_breadth_weighted_severity_or_model
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Joint issuer exposure across capacity, approval and innovation milestones.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Combining three unadmitted families or selecting severity, weights, ranks, filters or models would multiply hypotheses before any base source is accepted.

scientific_interpretation.safe_conclusion: Three distinct positive operating states remain deferred at source admission; terminal contract relabeling and two premature variant families are closed before rows, text or values.

next_action: Record all six decisions in an append-only Campaign167 ledger, publish terminal accounting and continue a different finite offline prevalue domain under the next policy.
